items.content:
One big result in our study at Procter & Gamble was that AI blurred the lines between jobs. Now OpenAI has a similar finding

Organizational boundaries are becoming porous, the walls thinning. Companies are going to need to think about division of labor in a new way, things are getting chaotic now.

items.content:
Continuing a trend, I had Fable build a working Rothko-inspired city builder based on the fake AI video I created a year ago. This time, the unique mechanic the AI developed is that you play with margins between colors & forms to grow your city

Its worth a few moments: threshold-city.netlify.app
